title: Scheduler skips the nightly export (fixture: open)
scenario: open: a Distill from the case menu on a still-open case that did load a skill; attribution is skipped as open (checked before the inventory), no judge call, no rows, no escape hatch

skills.name: fx-open-skill
skills.description: Use when a scheduled job silently skips a run; checks the timezone of the cron expression first.
skills.body:
# Diagnose skipped scheduled runs

## Steps
1. Check which timezone the cron expression is evaluated in.
2. Check whether a daylight-saving transition removes the scheduled hour.

messages.content: The nightly export skipped last night. Find out why.

I loaded the fx-open-skill skill and checked the cron timezone: the export is scheduled at 02:30 local time, and last night was the daylight-saving transition, so that hour did not exist. Not confirmed yet; I need the scheduler log to be sure.

findings.summary: The export is scheduled in an hour the daylight-saving transition removed (unconfirmed).
